name: W Santiago
insider_take: Santiago's electric energy meets W's signature style in this sleek urban playground, where the Andes Mountains provide a dramatic backdrop to cutting-edge luxury.
whats_special: Located in the heart of Las Condes, W Santiago occupies a prime spot in Chile's financial district with stunning views of the snow-capped Andes. The hotel's rooftop RED2ONE bar sits 21 floors up, offering panoramic city vistas and craft cocktails. The property features bold, contemporary design with local Chilean influences and houses NOSO restaurant, known for its innovative take on Chilean cuisine using indigenous ingredients like merkén spice and quinoa.
pro_tip: Visit the rooftop bar during sunset for the most spectacular Andes views, and don't miss trying a pisco sour made with local Chilean pisco - the hotel's mixologists are among the city's best.
dont_miss: The nearby Costanera Center, South America's tallest building with incredible city views from Sky Costanera observation deck. Explore the trendy Providencia neighborhood just minutes away, famous for its artisan markets, street art, and the bohemian Bellavista district where Nobel Prize winner Pablo Neruda's colorful house-museum La Chascona awaits discovery.
pros: Prime location in Las Condes financial district with easy access to shopping and dining
Stunning panoramic views of the Andes Mountains and Santiago skyline
Contemporary luxury design with signature W Hotels vibrant atmosphere
Exceptional rooftop bar and restaurant with breathtaking city views
cons: Modern design may not appeal to traditional luxury preferences
